I need you to extract ALL content from the deployed Broadstroke mailing site that was unzipped to /Users/henrytafolla/dev/template-microsite/sites/broadstroke/mailing/_zip_extract/mailing/

2. **JS bundle** at `_zip_extract/mailing/assets/index-CX_sP2Ik.js` - This is minified but contains ALL the site content (headlines, benefits, services, FAQs, etc). Search for key strings.
3. **Source map** at `_zip_extract/mailing/assets/index-CX_sP2Ik.js.map` - This maps minified code back to original source files. Look at the "sources" array and "sourcesContent" array to find the ORIGINAL TypeScript/TSX source code.

7. **Navigation**: all links, serviceLinks, companyLinks, cta
8. **SEO**: title, description, keywords, ogTitle, ogDescription, twitterTitle, twitterDescription
